CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

2. Which response best shows understanding of The Inspired Word of God? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Inspired Word of God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say The Inspired Word of God has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Inspired Word of God.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Inspired Word of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

4. Which response best shows understanding of Self-awareness? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self-awareness.
   B. Use Self-awareness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Self-awareness has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Self-awareness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   C. Use Zacchaeus the Tax Collector to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Zacchaeus the Tax Collector has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Samson kills a Lion? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Samson kills a Lion with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Samson kills a Lion.
   C. Use Samson kills a Lion to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Healing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Healing By the end of the sub and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Jesus raises a Widow’s Son and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Forgiveness and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
